title: 311. Read N Characters Given Read4 II - Call Multiple Times

examples.explanation: First call takes "a", second takes "bc", and the third finds nothing left.
The first call drains the file; the second returns empty.

hints: Keep one position pointer shared across all queries.
Each query takes file[pos:pos+q] and advances pos by the taken amount.
Once pos reaches the end, all later queries return empty strings.
